State_change_caption: The sequence of images captures the progressive action of opening a can with a manual can opener. Initially, the lid is barely punctured, but as the process continues, the metal is incrementally severed, revealing more of the can's contents. The turning motion required to operate the can opener is evident in the changing angles and positioning of the hands. By the final frame, the transformation from a sealed container to an accessible one is nearly complete, with just a small uncut section of the lid remaining, demonstrating the effectiveness and manual nature of the process.
